summary: EShallgo Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a registered direct offering of 200,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 each and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 550,000 shares at $0.99 per warrant (exercise price $0.01). The offering is a routine capital raise under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, with gross proceeds of up to $750,000. Univest Securities acts as placement agent (7% cash fee). Shares trade on Nasdaq at $2.67 (June 29, 2026). This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
